interface.shortDescription: Draw or check a user journey against the code, on an editable canvas
interface.longDescription: Draw a user journey from what a codebase actually does, or check an existing journey against current reality. Three lanes per step (person / system / invariant), every system claim cited to file:line, and a mandatory status card for what is unproven, unmerged, or undeployed. FigJam when available, self-contained HTML + PNG otherwise.
